policy: Bundle ceilings are 235000 raw / 71000 gzip bytes after the SVG and accessible-tabs refactor (measured 232606 / 70483; docs/v2/evidence/frontend-redesign.json). Local UI timing ceilings retain the original baseline and must be compared on the same machine/profile; CI enforces bundle size only. Budget changes require an explained new measurement. Catalog automation adds validated plugin metadata and health/recipe/result contracts. Shared generated schema objects reduce the measured raw bundle to 229577 bytes; gzip is 71309 bytes versus the prior 70483-byte baseline. The raw ceiling stays 235000; the gzip ceiling is 72000 to cover this measured contract expansion. The searchable shared icon registry and reusable uploaded-image picker add approximately 3 KB raw / 1 KB gzip; their measured build is 232501 raw / 72276 gzip. The raw ceiling remains 235000 and the compressed ceiling is 73000 for these additional controls. URL and server-local image imports with explicit cached live refresh add 3876 raw / 1195 gzip bytes to the prior icon build. Measured bundle: 236377 raw / 73471 gzip; ceilings are 240000 / 75000 to cover these new editor controls and ImageImport contracts. Timing budgets are unchanged. The contextual editor toolbar adds keyboard overflow actions, validated on-demand rename, protected root deletion and confirmation, and live save feedback. Measured bundle: 241288 raw / 74891 gzip, versus 236377 / 73471 before the toolbar change. The raw ceiling is 245000; gzip stays at 75000 and timing budgets are unchanged.
